content: We need to determine SMILES of unknown compound given only description? No data provided. We have no spectra yet. We need to acquire data using tools, but minimize cost. We need to identify molecule. Likely we need to run mass spec, NMR, etc. But we have no initial clue. Perhaps the sample is unknown; we need to deduce from spectra. So we must request measurements. Start with mass spectrometry to get molecular weight. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool.
